astro_fits_write — FILEIO fits op

• Data kinds: any → any

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.astro_fits_write(image, *, header) (to call the implementation directly, import fileio; fileio.astro_fits_write(image, *, header); from the registry, opsfileio.get("astro_fits_write"))

Usage

Write a 2-D/3-D astronomical image and basic WCS as primary-HDU FITS bytes.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

header は FITS の基本 WCS キー(CTYPE*, CRPIX*, CRVAL*, CDELT*, PC*_*, CD*_*, CUNIT* など)だけを持つ辞書。構造キーは配列から作り、uint16/uint32 は標準の BZERO 規約で保存する。呼び出し例:

payload = astro_fits_write(image, header={"CTYPE1": "RA---TAN"})。
